title: A strange true fact
text: A real fact goes up with a blank.

scene.tv: In 1932, Australia lost a war against ____.

title: Write a lie
text: Fill the blank with a believable fake.

title: Find the truth
text: The truth hides among the lies. Pick the one you think is real.

title: Scoring
text: Big points for finding the truth, and more for every player your tall tale fooled.
